item.title: What Edu is reading this week (Sep 19 - 26, 2026)
item.description: Two frontier model releases shared the week with a widening set of small decision models and agent runtimes, and with more reports on how coding agents are changing day-to-day development. Jev is still trending for the second week running, with benchmark tooling, an open implementation and drop-in skills for moving the small decisions off the frontier models. On the infrastructure side: kernel live-update work to keep VMs running, DRBD releases, router and Android tooling, and a Playdate app for watching live air traffic.
